$:set -e
name=$(gh codespace list --repo BestNameYet/Terminals --json name,repository --jq '.[]|select(.repository=="BestNameYet/Terminals")|.name' | head -n 1)
gh codespace ssh -c "$name" -- "bash -lc 'env | grep -q \"^MCP_GH_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=.\" && echo login_shell_secret=present || echo login_shell_secret=missing; env | grep -q \"^CODESPACE_NAME=.\" && echo login_shell_name=present || echo login_shell_name=missing'"
printf '\nUser Codespaces secret names:\n'
gh api user/codespaces/secrets --jq '.secrets[].name' || true
